Gray_banner marks the workshop area where light_blue_wool blocks are placed on the floor directly adjacent for mining

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Blue ice structure is centered at (0, 1, -10) relative to spawn. Player must navigate within 8 blocks and face toward it. Max_distance=8 ensures the player cannot trivially satisfy this from spawn (blue_ice is ~10 blocks north).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Polar bear is summoned at (0, 1, -8), 2 blocks south of blue_ice. Player must be within 8 blocks and facing toward it. The bear may wander slightly but stays in the icy area within tolerance.

Uses inventory_has because eating requires first obtaining the item from the chest. Chest at (3, 1, -9) contains 2 cooked_beef. After eating at least 1, player retains at least 1. This is a proxy for eating since direct consumption tracking is unavailable with current rule types. Hunger effect applied at spawn ensures eating is mechanically possible.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Gray banner is at (10, 1, -2) marking the workshop area. Player must navigate within 8 blocks and face toward it. Banner is ~10 blocks from spawn so max_distance=8 requires meaningful eastward movement.

Uses inventory_has because mining light_blue_wool drops the wool block item into inventory. Wool drops itself when mined with any tool or bare hands. Shears provided for faster breaking. Wool blocks are at (9-11, 1, 0) and (9, 2, 0) in the workshop.

Uses inventory_has because mining cobblestone_wall with a pickaxe drops the cobblestone_wall item into inventory. The wall at (9, 1, -7) physically blocks the shaft to ancient_debris below. Diamond pickaxe provided. Mining this is a physical prerequisite for accessing ancient_debris.

Uses inventory_has because crafting oak_fence_gate produces the item in inventory. Recipe: 4 sticks + 2 oak_planks at crafting table (12, 1, 1). Materials (2 oak_planks + 4 sticks) are in the workshop chest at (12, 1, -1).

Uses inventory_has because mining ancient_debris with a diamond pickaxe drops the ancient_debris item into inventory. Block is at (9, -2, -7), accessed by dropping through the shaft after mining the cobblestone_wall above. Diamond pickaxe provided and required (only diamond+ can mine ancient_debris).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Yellow stained glass column is at (-11, 2, 0) in the glass gallery (west). Player must navigate within 8 blocks and face toward it. Gallery is ~11 blocks from spawn so max_distance=8 requires meaningful westward movement.

Uses inventory_has because crafting blue_stained_glass produces the item in inventory. Recipe: 8 glass + 1 blue_dye in 3x3 grid at crafting table (-8, 1, 0). Materials are in the gallery chest at (-10, 1, 0). Produces 8 blue_stained_glass; checking min_count=1.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Azure bluet flower is at (0, 1, 10) in the southern flower garden. Player must navigate within 8 blocks and face toward it. Garden is ~10 blocks from spawn so max_distance=8 requires meaningful southward movement.

Uses inventory_has because crafting sugar from sugar_cane produces sugar in inventory. Recipe: 1 sugar_cane → 1 sugar (shapeless, works in 2x2 inventory grid). Player must first break sugar cane at (2-3, 1, 9) near the flower garden.

scene_description: A compact compound featuring an icy polar area (north), a woodworking/textile workshop (east), a glass gallery (west), a flower garden with sugar cane (south), and a netherite mining pit (northeast). Designed for 12 sequential tasks with genuine spatial and physical dependencies.
task_text: Explore the arctic workshop compound. Find blue ice and a polar bear in the icy area, then eat beef from the nearby chest. Find the gray banner marking the workshop to mine light blue wool and craft an oak fence gate. Mine the cobblestone wall blocking the mining shaft, then mine ancient debris below. Find yellow stained glass in the gallery, then craft blue stained glass. Find the azure bluet in the garden, then craft sugar from nearby sugar cane. Complete all 12 objectives.
